title: AGENTS.md Open Questions item 1 ('SCHC rule distribution') contradicts settled decision 2 'pre-provisioned, not negotiated'
description: Found during edge-cases codereview pass of bijq (delegated to kimi-k3). AGENTS.md 'Open Questions (Check Before Implementing)' item 1 asks 'SCHC rule distribution - Pre-provisioned vs. negotiated', but Key Technical Decisions item 2 states as settled: 'Rules are pre-provisioned, not negotiated' — and spec/03-adaptation.md 5.5 documents the rule registry as pre-provisioned. The open question is stale and misleads agents into treating a settled decision as open. Fix: remove item 1 from Open Questions (or replace with a pointer to the settled decision), leaving time-sync and DANE items. Discovered-from project-LICHEN-worker6-bijq.
